{{Quote|I know a lot of you don't trust me anymore to keep you safe. I know you don't all agree with me that hiding from the Empire should have been our number one priority all these years.|Rel Harsol|<ref name="Beyond the Rim">''[[Beyond the Rim]]''</ref>}}
'''Rel Harsol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and captain who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], but defected to the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederacy]] at the start of the war. After fleeing to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was formed, his ship, the [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] crashed on [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. There Harsol led the survivors in establishing a colony to hide from the Empire and learned to survive the dangers of the jungle planet.

==Biography==
{{Quote|So, let's take a few minutes to ask some questions, and see what everyone thinks.|Rel Harsol|<ref name="Beyond the Rim" />}}
Prior to the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rel Harsol served aboard the personal [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of a well known [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. He became disillusioned with the Republic after witnessing first-hand the corrupt and self-serving deals made by the senator to further his own wealth and power. At the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he defected to the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Separatist Navy]] where he rose through the ranks, even serving aboard the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Eventually Harsol won command of the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']].

Near the end of the Clone Wars, Harson foresaw the Confederacy's defeat and made plans accordingly. He developed a friendship with [[Cratala]], the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Scientist/Legends|cyberneticist]] and director of the [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] [[Laboratory/Legends|lab]] on the planet his ship protected. He also began intercepting and stockpiling [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] intended for the lab and any other wealth for "safekeeping" aboard the ''Sa Nalaor''. Both fearing reprisal for their actions against the Republic, Harsol and Cratala developed a plan to flee to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. There they would continue Cratala's cybernetics research, selling her technology through a [[IsoTech|supply company]] owned by [[Ropok]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] operating out of [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]].

When the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched a raid on the former Separatist cybernetics facility, Harsol fled with Cratala and her research aboard the ''Sa Nalaor''. However, when they reached their destination of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], something caused the ship to crash instead. The ''Sa Nalaor'' split in two when it impacted the surface of Cholganna with the main hull and the engine section coming to rest separately in the jungles of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Harsol attempted to send a [[Distress beacon/Legends|message beacon]] to Ropok to inform him of their location, but it never arrived. Both Cratala and Harsol were among the survivors of the crash. Harsol took command of the situation and with the other survivors established [[The Retreat]] settlement, and learned how to survive against the many dangers of the jungle, including [[Nexu/Legends|nexus]] and [[Arboreal octopus/Legends|arboreal octopi]]. Harsol was the de-facto leader of the group, while Cratala served as the settlement's [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]], while maintaining her cybernetics research aboard the wreckage of the ship.
